argv: Round 4: Analysis: on train pairs the clean (main-freq) part of the 44 live neurons gets ~79% acc; held-out is lower because the memorization residue adds logit noise (std ~2.1) and the generalizing circuit lacks capacity. Single neurons and mirror pairs leave large uncancelled junk (linear, DC, a-b terms). The 84 dead neurons sit at ~5e-6 with zero moments, so they get no gradient and need a seed. Edit: seeded 11 dead neurons as quadrature partners (input phases +/-pi/2, so S+pi) of the mirror pairs at k=16,19,20,22,46 (2 each) and of neuron 98 (k=28). Only input weights were set, and sparsely: amplitude 1.1*cos on the entries where |cos|>0.85 (0.9 for the last one), ~70 entries per neuron, 738 total, optimizer moments reset. Outputs stay zero and the optimizer grows them; the unset inputs fill in from the gradient. Trials (1000 steps): 7 neurons at 50% mask 59->70.5%; 10 neurons at 36% mask (this edit minus the k=28 one) 59->71.3%, still rising ~1.2%/100 steps, train loss 0.17; 13 neurons at 29% mask 67.4%, slower start. Unlike earlier rounds, held-out rose steadily with no peak-and-decay.
